_what: The words of the workspace's focus at the top of the sidebar (parts/ui/show/rule-filter/FocusEditor.tsx, mounted by src/workspace/main.tsx): what the whole workspace is about now and the menu that switches it. {count} is how many things a focus on several names. `opens` are the menu's last rows, each opening a screen by its id (All pursuits: every pursuit, the invitations waiting for an answer and the archived ones), since that list is reached from the switcher rather than being a row of the sidebar.
